mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 51 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library and a Waning Gibbous moon above. Please note the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. We are looking at an overnight low of 49 degrees with rain likely to fall.
We have checked the city updates and there are no new emails or news items to report for today.

There is plenty going on, starting with live music at Bailey's Run today, the Main Street trick-or-treat event today, and live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Looking ahead, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow or check out live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
The Verona Police Department has reported no activity for the weekly period.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 25 minutes, so there is still time to stop by for a late-night dessert.
